description: Dates for a meeting, answered by whoever is coming. The organiser puts up times; everyone else says which ones work for them — none, one or all of them. Who may put a date up, whether a closed poll still takes one, and that a person answers a date once are the database's to enforce — triggers and unique indexes rather than board logic — so it refuses what the page would not have offered, and says why. Every tap enters the same pipeline, and the queries at its end re-read what it changed.

state.schema:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS poll (
  name      TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  organiser TEXT NOT NULL,
  closed    INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS option (
  id         INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  poll       TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- Who put the date up: what the trigger below checks it against.
  proposedBy TEXT NOT NULL,
  starts     TEXT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT a_date_and_a_time
             CHECK (starts GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9] [0-9][0-9]:[0-9][0-9]')
);
-- A date is on the poll once, however often it is put up.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS one_option_per_time
  ON option (poll, starts);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS vote (
  id     INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
  option INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES option (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  voter  TEXT NOT NULL,
  castAt TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now'))
);
-- One person, one answer per date: a second tap cannot count twice.
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS one_vote_per_option
  ON vote (option, voter);
-- The three rules a WHERE clause would only decline to break. Said here they
-- are refused with a reason, which is what the board has to show a person.
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS the_organiser_puts_up_the_dates
BEFORE INSERT ON option
WHEN NEW.proposedBy IS NOT (SELECT organiser FROM poll WHERE name = NEW.poll)
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'only the person who called the meeting can put up a date');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS a_closed_poll_takes_no_dates
BEFORE INSERT ON option
WHEN (SELECT closed FROM poll WHERE name = NEW.poll) = 1
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the poll is closed');
END;
CREATE TRIGGER IF NOT EXISTS a_closed_poll_takes_no_answers
BEFORE INSERT ON vote
WHEN (SELECT p.closed FROM poll p JOIN option o ON o.poll = p.name
       WHERE o.id = NEW.option) = 1
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'the poll is closed');
END;
state.statement:
INSERT OR IGNORE INTO poll (name, organiser)
SELECT trim($poll), trim($actor)
 WHERE $intent IN ('seed', 'create')
   AND trim($poll)  <> ''
   AND trim($actor) <> ''

INSERT INTO option (poll, proposedBy, starts)
SELECT $poll, trim($actor), at
  FROM (
    SELECT date('now', 'localtime', '+3 days') || ' 10:00' AS at
    UNION ALL SELECT date('now', 'localtime', '+3 days') || ' 15:30'
    UNION ALL SELECT date('now', 'localtime', '+4 days') || ' 09:30'
    UNION ALL SELECT date('now', 'localtime', '+8 days') || ' 11:00'
  )
 WHERE $intent = 'seed'
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM option WHERE poll = $poll)
   AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM poll WHERE name = $poll AND organiser = trim($actor)
   )

INSERT INTO option (poll, proposedBy, starts)
SELECT $poll, trim($actor), trim($starts)
 WHERE $intent = 'propose'

DELETE FROM option
 WHERE $intent = 'withdraw'
   AND id   = $option
   AND poll = $poll
   AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM poll
      WHERE name = $poll AND organiser = trim($actor) AND closed = 0
   )

INSERT INTO vote (option, voter)
SELECT $option, trim($actor)
 WHERE $intent = 'vote'
   AND trim($actor) <> ''

DELETE FROM vote
 WHERE $intent = 'unvote'
   AND option = $option
   AND voter  = trim($actor)
   AND EXISTS (
     SELECT 1 FROM option o JOIN poll p ON p.name = o.poll
      WHERE o.id = $option AND o.poll = $poll AND p.closed = 0
   )

UPDATE poll
   SET closed = CASE $intent WHEN 'close' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
 WHERE $intent IN ('close', 'reopen')
   AND name      = $poll
   AND organiser = trim($actor)

WITH
  answers AS (
    SELECT o.id     AS id,
           o.starts AS starts,
           count(v.id) AS yes,
           coalesce(group_concat(v.voter, ', '), '') AS voters,
           max(CASE WHEN v.voter = trim($actor) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mine
      FROM option o
      LEFT JOIN vote v ON v.option = o.id
     WHERE o.poll = $poll
     GROUP BY o.id, o.starts
  ),
  best(n)  AS (SELECT coalesce(max(yes), 0) FROM answers),
  meeting  AS (SELECT organiser, closed FROM poll WHERE name = $poll)
SELECT
  a.id     AS id,
  a.starts AS starts,
  a.yes    AS yes,
  a.mine   AS mine,
  CASE strftime('%w', substr(a.starts, 1, 10))
    WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue'
    WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri'
    ELSE 'Sat'
  END || ' ' || substr(a.starts, 1, 10) || ' at ' || substr(a.starts, 12, 5) AS label,
  CASE WHEN a.yes = 0 THEN 'Nobody yet' ELSE a.voters END AS who,
  CASE
    WHEN a.yes = best.n AND best.n > 0 THEN a.yes || ' yes - best so far'
    ELSE a.yes || ' yes'
  END AS score,
  CASE WHEN a.mine = 1 THEN 'unvote' ELSE 'vote' END AS intent,
  CASE WHEN a.mine = 1 THEN 'Take it back' ELSE 'Works for me' END AS answerLabel,
  CASE
    WHEN m.closed = 1 OR trim($actor) = '' THEN 1
    ELSE 0
  END AS locked,
  CASE
    WHEN m.organiser = trim($actor) AND m.closed = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE 1
  END AS notYours,
  'Take ' || a.starts || ' off the poll, along with every answer given to it?' AS dropPrompt
FROM answers a
CROSS JOIN best
LEFT JOIN meeting m ON 1 = 1
ORDER BY a.starts

SELECT
  p.name      AS name,
  p.organiser AS organiser,
  p.closed    AS closed,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM option o WHERE o.poll = p.name) AS dates,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT v.voter)
     FROM vote v JOIN option o ON o.id = v.option
    WHERE o.poll = p.name) AS people,
  CASE
    WHEN p.closed = 1
      THEN 'Closed by ' || p.organiser || '. The answers stand as they are.'
    WHEN p.organiser = trim($actor)
      THEN 'You called this meeting, so you put up the dates and you close the poll.'
    ELSE 'Called by ' || p.organiser || ', who puts up the dates. Answer the ones that work for you.'
  END AS notice,
  CASE WHEN p.organiser = trim($actor) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS notYours,
  CASE WHEN p.closed = 1 THEN 'Reopen the poll' ELSE 'Close the poll' END AS closeLabel,
  CASE WHEN p.closed = 1 THEN 'reopen' ELSE 'close' END AS closeIntent,
  CASE
    WHEN p.closed = 1 THEN 'Let people answer ' || p.name || ' again?'
    ELSE 'Close voting on ' || p.name || '?'
  END AS closePrompt
FROM poll p
WHERE p.name = $poll

SELECT
  p.name AS name,
  CASE WHEN p.name = $poll THEN '• ' ELSE '' END
    || p.name
    || CASE WHEN p.closed = 1 THEN ' (closed)' ELSE '' END AS label
FROM poll p
ORDER BY p.created DESC, p.name

items.placeholder: Answer every date that works for you — none, one or all of them. Change who you are to answer as somebody else: it is the same poll seen from another desk. Putting dates up and closing the meeting are on Organise.
